title: BI Developer (Power BI)
description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your Role As a Data Analyst at Kyndryl, you will unlock the power of data to drive strategic decisions and shape the future of our business. You will harness your expertise in data analysis, business fundamentals, statistics, and communication to uncover valuable insights and transform raw data into meaningful visualizations and compelling stories that influence real-world outcomes. You will have the opportunity to work with vast and complex datasets, helping customers better understand their environments through data-driven insights. By identifying trends, patterns, and opportunities within the data, you will enable smarter decision-making and support business transformation initiatives across the organization. Join Kyndryl and gain the trust, autonomy, and collaboration needed to help organizations turn data into one of their most valuable assets. What You Will Do Collect, organize, structure, and clean data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis. Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, root causes, anomalies, and opportunities for business improvement. Develop insightful reports, dashboards, visualizations, and data-driven recommendations for business stakeholders. Collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives, project requirements, and success criteria. Translate complex business problems into analytical approaches and actionable solutions. Leverage statistical methods, business intelligence tools, and analytical techniques to generate meaningful insights. Communicate findings effectively through storytelling, presentations, and visualizations that influence business decisions. Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying data quality issues, process inefficiencies, and opportunities for optimization. Partner with technical and business teams to ensure data is properly prepared and aligned with organizational goals. Drive data-informed decision making by delivering accurate, timely, and actionable analysis. If you have a passion for analytics, problem-solving, and transforming data into business value, this is the position for you. You will work with talented professionals and collaborate on innovative projects that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data. Your Future at Kyndryl As a Data Analyst, you will work closely with business leaders, customers, data professionals, and technology teams to solve complex challenges through data. Whether you aspire to become a Data Scientist, Business Intelligence Specialist, Analytics Consultant, Data Engineer, or Data Architect, Kyndryl provides the opportunities, mentorship, and resources to help accelerate your career growth. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important, you have a growth mindset and are keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused, someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless, naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Expertise 4+ years of hands-on experience in Power BI development, including report design, dashboard creation, and enterprise reporting solutions. Strong expertise in DAX, including filter context, row context, CALCULATE, iterators, variables, measures, and time intelligence functions. Strong expertise in Power Query (M Language), including complex transformations, merges, appends, query optimization, and incremental refresh. Experience designing and maintaining end-to-end Power BI solutions from source connectivity through deployment and production support. Strong understanding of data modeling concepts, including star schema, fact and dimension tables, relationships, cardinality, and model optimization. Experience building and maintaining semantic models that serve as trusted reporting layers for business users. Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, window functions, stored procedures, and query performance tuning. Understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, dimensional modeling, and Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD). Experience implementing Row-Level Security (RLS), workspace permissions, and application security models. Hands-on experience with Power BI Service, deployment pipelines, gateways, refresh scheduling, and report lifecycle management. Experience troubleshooting and optimizing report performance using tools such as Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio, Tabular Editor, and VertiPaq Analyzer. Experience integrating data from SQL Server, Azure SQL, SharePoint, Excel, APIs, SAP, Oracle, and cloud-based data platforms. Preferred Technical and Professional Experience Microsoft PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst) certification or equivalent Power BI certifications. Experience with external Power BI tools such as Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, ALM Toolkit, Measure Killer, and Best Practice Analyzer. Experience working with Power BI MCP and modern Power BI governance practices. Working knowledge of Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, and other Azure data services. Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Data Warehousing, Lakehouse, and Real-Time Analytics capabilities. Experience supporting enterprise reporting environments with governance, version control, and deployment standards. Knowledge of report migration, dashboard consolidation, and semantic model standardization initiatives. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.
